key.name: opacity
key.description: One setting for Isle's glass, the dock, app windows (blur my shell) and DigUp's panel: 0 is clear, 100 is solid.

key.name: blur
key.description: Frosted glass behind the dock and app windows (DigUp's panel can't blur: it is a full-screen window).

key.name: accent
key.description: The one accent of the desktop: Isle's highlights, the dock's running dots, DigUp's selection.

key.name: tint
key.description: The colour of the dark surfaces (the dock, DigUp's panel).
